subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR preserve the existing blocked terminal state after exhausted compaction and leave model fallback redesign to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986?
rationale: The patch correctly fixes the reported classification under the current runner contract, but the assigned reviewer requested a broader terminal behavior change affecting all context-overflow handling.

options.title: Keep Narrow Scope
options.body: Approve the Anthropic classifier fix under the current overflow contract and handle fallback redesign separately.

options.title: Require Combined Redesign
options.body: Keep requested changes until this PR also adds a failoverable terminal outcome after bounded compaction.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Scope
recommendation.body: Approve the Anthropic classifier fix under the current overflow contract and handle fallback redesign separately.
